Where Luxury Meets Leisure
The Kentucky Castle hotel welcomes you with luxurious suites thoughtfully designed to provide comfort, elegance, and a sense of wonder. With 18 distinctive accommodations, including our iconic Tower Suites, serene Farm View Cabin, and charming Tiny Homes, each room is tailored to provide comfort, elegance, and a touch of enchantment. Whether you're indulging in a romantic getaway, celebrating a special occasion, or simply seeking a relaxing getaway, here at The Kentucky Castle, every moment is memorable.

Your Table is Waiting
Dine with us for an experience rooted in Kentucky heritage and elevated with culinary creativity. Our property-to-plate philosophy guides every dish, showcasing ingredients grown right here on The Kentucky Castle Farm and sourced from local purveyors. From seasonally inspired menus and handcrafted cocktails, every menu showcases a journey from our property to your plate, highlighting fresh, local, and seasonal ingredients. Join us at the table, where flavor, tradition, and storytelling come together within the walls of a castle.

The Kentucky Castle
In the heart of Central Kentucky lies a 55-year-old castle, with views of 110 acres of rolling bluegrass farmland. A destination that seamlessly merges historical intrigue with modern sophistication, The Kentucky Castle's architecture, grounds, and exceptional hospitality mark it a premier destination for locals and travelers alike. The Kentucky Castle represents a rich history of vision, resilience, and revitalization. Its transformation from an unfinished estate to a fully realized luxury destination is a testament to the dedication of those who have preserved its legacy. The Kentucky Castle offers an unparalleled opportunity to stay, dine, experience, and relax.Discover the elegance and enchantment of The Kentucky Castle where history and hospitality converge to deliver a truly exceptional experience.

An Unforgettable Stay
Experience true southern hospitality at The Kentucky Castle. With thoughtfully designed accommodations ranging from elegant interior rooms to iconic tower suites, each space offers a unique blend of character, comfort, and luxury. Whether you're planning a romantic retreat, a family vacation, or a weekend to unwind, your stay at the Kentucky Castle is destined to be both restorative and memorable.
Book your Room
View Hotel Packages
Accomodations
Rooms
Sleeps 2 | 1 King Bed | Castle Interior
Tucked inside the Castle's walls, these elegant rooms feature a plush king bed and are located on the first or second floor. Ideal for a refined escape for one or two.
Suites
Sleeps 2 | 1 King Bed | Private Terrace Access
Enjoy added space with our interior Suites, offering a king bed and a sitting room. Suites have exclusive access to a terrace perfect for morning coffee or evening stargazing.
Tower Suites
Sleeps 2 | 1 King Bed | Kitchenette
Housed in the Castle's iconic towers, these multi-level suites include a king bed and kitchenette, offering a more private and unique stay with breathtaking views.
Farm House
Sleeps 8 | 4 Beds | Private Deck
Located on the Castle grounds, the Farmhouse sleeps up to 8 guests with 4 beds, full amenities, and a private deck. A perfect fit for families or group getaways.
Cabin
Sleeps 8 | 4 Beds | Castle View
With panoramic views of the Castle, this spacious cabin accommodates 8 guests and combines rustic comfort with luxury touches. Enjoy your morning coffee on the porch swing overlooking our working farm.
Tiny Homes
Sleeps 2 | 1 King Bed | Privacy
For a minimalist yet intimate experience, our Tiny Homes offer a cozy king bed, kitchenette, and a full bath, all just steps from the Castle, our farm, and Spa.
Hotel Gallery
During Your Stay
Your experience extends far beyond your room. Guests are welcomed to dine at our acclaimed property-to-plate restaurant, where seasonal menus highlight ingredients sourced from the Castle's grounds. Unwind at the Spa, where our expert massage therapists deliver personalized treatments designed for deep relaxation and renewal. Finally, embark on a tour that explores the rich history of the estate, or book a curated event like our murder mystery dinners, afternoon teas, or seasonal markets. No matter how you plan your stay with us, you're sure to have an unforgettable experience.

FAQ
What time is check-in and check out?
Check-in is at 4:00 PM and check-out is at 11:00 AM. Early check-in or late check-out may be requested for a fee and based on availability.
Are children allowed to stay at The Kentucky Castle?
Yes, families are welcome. The Farmhouse and Cabin are ideal for larger groups or family stays.
Is the hotel pet-friendly?
Yes, we are dog-friendly. Dogs must be less than 40lbs with a maximum of two pets per room, $125 per pet per stay.
Do you offer room service?
Yes, in-room dining is available during restaurant hours for hotel guests.
How close is the Castle to downtown Lexington or Keeneland?
The Kentucky Castle is just minutes from Keeneland Race Track and Blue Grass Airport, and about 15 minutes from downtown Lexington.
Do you offer packages for special occasions?
Yes, we offer add-on experiences and packages for romantic getaways, birthdays, and more. You'll find add-on options available when you make your booking.

Our Story
The Kentucky Castle is one of Central Kentucky's most iconic landmarks. For more than half a century, this extraordinary estate, turned luxury hotel, has captured the imagination of locals and travelers alike.
In 1969, Rex and Caroline Martin set out to build a castle in the heart of Kentucky, inspired by their travels through Europe. But before it could be completed, the Martins separated, and construction came to a halt. For more than 30 years, the unfinished castle stood as a local curiosity.
Despite its incomplete state, it embodied a unique vision, one that would eventually flourish under the stewardship of new owners determined to honor its original grandeur while expanding its offerings.
In the early 2000s, new owners undertook the massive effort of restoring and completing the castle, breathing life into its grand halls. In 2004, a structure fire damaged the property, but ultimately led to the restoration of our beloved Kentucky Castle. The property was rebuilt and opened its doors to the public for the first time in 2008.
In 2017, another ownership change took place, and over the span of the next several years, they leaned into the castle's unique property as a place to stay, dine, and relax in addition to developing a working farm with vibrant gardens and farm animals. In 2023, the castle was sold to TKC Hospitality Group.
The Kentucky Castle stands as a testament to vision, resilience, and revitalization. What began as an unfinished dream is now a thriving symbol of Kentucky's beauty, creativity, and enduring charm. We invite you to discover it for yourself, and experience a destination where history lives, luxury awaits, and every stay tells a story. Join us for a
castle tour to hear the full story.
We can't wait to see you soon!
